producer_report.summary: I fixed the client and early cycle by moving EARLY_RUN_WAIT back into gh/client.rs, next to PrHost::early_run_wait. gh/mod.rs re-exports it from client, so `gh::EARLY_RUN_WAIT` still resolves, and client.rs no longer imports from super for it. Everything else in the earlier move stays as it was. The CHANGELOG G6 entry now says EARLY_RUN_WAIT stays in client.rs. It also says mod.rs keeps `load_early_link` and `store_early` under `#[cfg(test)]`, and that early.rs uses remote and `LandPr` until G7. structure-pass.md section 3.1 now records the EARLY_RUN_WAIT placement and the note for G7. I ran clippy, the 75 gh tests and the policy test; all pass. `cargo fmt --all --check` failed once on import order in mod.rs, which `cargo fmt --all` fixed. I did not run the full suite or the `--list` comparison.
